diagnostics.title: Unrecognized Token / Lexer Error
diagnostics.explanation: The lexer encountered an unexpected character that does not form part of any valid Kora token.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Check for invalid unicode characters or misformatted literals.

diagnostics.title: Syntax Error / Unexpected Token
diagnostics.explanation: The parser encountered a token where a different syntactic construct was expected.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Ensure braces, parentheses, and semicolons are balanced and correctly placed.

diagnostics.title: Use of Banned 'undefined' Keyword
diagnostics.explanation: Kora adheres to the Single-Null Standard (Rule 01). Only 'null' is permitted.

diagnostics.title: Undefined Identifier
diagnostics.explanation: A variable, function, or type name was referenced without prior declaration or import in scope.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Declare the variable with `let` or import the required module.

diagnostics.title: Type Mismatch
diagnostics.explanation: An expression evaluated to a type that does not match the expected destination type.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Provide explicit conversion, or correct the variable/return type annotation.

diagnostics.title: Missing Required Struct/Model Field
diagnostics.explanation: A model or struct initialization is missing one or more mandatory non-optional fields.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Provide values for all declared non-optional fields in the struct literal.

diagnostics.title: Class Missing Interface Method Implementation
diagnostics.explanation: A class declared that it implements an interface, but failed to implement one or more methods.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Implement all required methods declared in the interface.

diagnostics.title: Controller Directly Accessing Database or Repository
diagnostics.explanation: Clean Architecture Layer Violation (Rule 04). Controllers cannot directly access database handles.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Inject a domain Service into the Controller and delegate database operations through the service.

diagnostics.title: Service Instantiating Repository Directly
diagnostics.explanation: Dependency Inversion Violation (Rule 04). Services must receive repository contracts via `init(...)`.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Declare the repository interface as a constructor parameter in `init(...)`.

diagnostics.title: Entity Leak to Transport Layer
diagnostics.explanation: A database entity decorated with @table was returned directly in an API response or controller.
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Map the entity to a pure DTO model before returning to the transport layer.

diagnostics.title: Missing Load Test Teardown / Resource Leak
diagnostics.explanation: Load and stress tests must explicitly teardown and release allocated resources (Rule 10).
diagnostics.suggestedFix: Implement explicit cleanup or shutdown of server instances, pools, and test fixtures.
